title: 2', 4'-Dihydroxy-2,3-dimethoxychalcone: A pharmacological inverse agonist of RORgammat ameliorating Th17-driven inflammatory diseases by regulating Th17/Treg.
authors: Qi, Wen-Hui; Zhang, Yan-Yan; Xing, Kun; Hao, Dong-Xia; Zhang, Fei; Wang, Rui-Ning; Bao, Ming-Yue; Tian, Meng-Yuan; Yang, Ya-Na; Li, Xing; Zhang, Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构虚拟筛选发现查尔酮衍生物DDC作为RORγt反向激动剂调节Th17/Treg平衡，虽涉及转录因子RORγt与配体结合口袋，但核心是药物小分子-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Multiple sclerosis, inflammatory bowel disease and organ transplant rejection are related to Th17 cell development and inflammatory respond. RORgammat, a specific transcription factor regulating Th17 cell differentiation, is a pivotal target for the treatment of diseases. However, the clinical application of RORgammat inverse agonists reported so far has been hindered due to limited efficacy and toxic side effects. Plant-derived natural products with drug-like properties and safety are wide and valuable resources for candidate drug discovery. Herein, structure-based virtual screening was used to find out 2',4'-Dihydroxy-2,3-dimethoxychalcone (DDC), a chalcone derivative rich in plants and food, located in the binding pocket of RORgammat and targeted to inhibit RORgammat activity. DDC repressed murine Th17 differentiation and promoted Treg differentiation remarkably in a dose-dependent manner. In addition, DDC treatment improved experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis recovery, ameliorated experimental colitis severity, and prevented graft rejection significantly. Mechanically, DDC indirectly stabilized Foxp3 expression by inhibiting RORgammat activity and the expression of its target gene profile in vitro and in vivo, which realized its regulation of Th17/Treg balance. In conclusion, our study provides a scientific basis that DDC, as an inverse agonist of RORgammat with simple structure, rich sources, low cost, high efficiency, and low toxicity, has great potential for the development of a novel effective immunomodulator for the treatment of Th17-mediated inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症、炎症性肠病及器官移植排斥反应与Th17细胞发育及炎症反应相关。RORgammat作为调控Th17细胞分化的特异性转录因子，是治疗这些疾病的关键靶点。然而，迄今报道的RORgammat反向激动剂因疗效有限和毒副作用，其临床应用受到阻碍。具有类药性和安全性的植物来源天然产物是候选药物发现的广泛且宝贵的资源。在此，我们利用基于结构的虚拟筛选发现了2',4'-二羟基-2,3-二甲氧基查尔酮（DDC），一种富含于植物和食物中的查尔酮衍生物，它定位于RORgammat的结合口袋，并靶向抑制RORgammat活性。DDC以剂量依赖性方式显著抑制小鼠Th17分化并促进Treg分化。此外，DDC治疗显著改善了实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎的恢复，减轻了实验性结肠炎的严重程度，并预防了移植物排斥反应。机制上，DDC通过抑制RORgammat活性及其靶基因谱的表达，在体外和体内间接稳定Foxp3表达，从而实现其对Th17/Treg平衡的调控。总之，我们的研究提供了科学依据，表明DDC作为结构简单、来源丰富、成本低、效率高且毒性低的RORgammat反向激动剂，在开发治疗Th17介导炎症性疾病的新型有效免疫调节剂方面具有巨大潜力。
